_comment: Phase 2 perception weights. Committed metadata only - the .onnx files themselves are git-ignored and fetched by `python scripts/fetch_models.py`, which verifies each sha256 below and refuses to touch anything on a mismatch. Pre-exported ONNX published by Ultralytics; no torch / ultralytics package is needed to run them.

detector.license_note: Ultralytics YOLO11 is AGPL-3.0. See docs/attribution.md - releasing this repository under a non-AGPL licence while shipping these weights is an OPEN, UNRESOLVED decision.

pose.license_note: Same AGPL-3.0 open decision as the detector.

detector_alt.license_note: Phase 2.5 permissively-licensed comparison detector (Megvii YOLOX). Evaluated on the identical eval set so the AGPL-3.0 licence decision is settled by evidence - see docs/attribution.md and results/model_comparison.md.
